desc: Derive the optimal phase ordering: all 1-to-0 flips first in descending \(C_i\), followed by all 0-to-1 flips in ascending \(C_i\).
Establish that useful redundant operations can only be temporary off/on toggles of bits with \(A_i=B_i=1\); other redundant toggles are removable.
Derive the cost formula for selecting a subset \(P\) of common 1-bits.
Prove that for fixed \(|P|=r\), the objective is minimized by selecting the \(r\) largest \(C_i\) among common 1-bits.
Correct the initial \(Q_{\text{off}}\) coefficient orientation and validate the complete algorithm against all public samples.
